tortoise: Hoo! Somewhere in the old Agora a very slow friend is wandering. Be patient and tap it.
areopagus: Hoo! They say the Areopagus is strange at sunset. Stand still on top of it for a little while.
cat: Hoo! A cat is asleep on a fallen column up on the summit. Cats like being tapped, do they not?
feather: Hoo! Something shiny is tucked away near {area}. Look by the walls and trees.
